body.heading: About this sheet
paragraphs: Free SparkKindly Kids crosswords printable: Mini Crossword 17.
A mini crossword with picture-friendly clues — small grids, kind words, and the lovely click when across and down agree.

body.heading: How to use it
paragraphs: Print the sheet, read each clue, and pencil answers in lightly — when an across and a down word share a letter, they must match, and that letter is a free hint.

takeaway: Crosswords stretch spelling, vocabulary and stubbornness in the best way.
materials: A pencil and a good eraser
supervision: Be the clue-reading partner, not the answer key — wondering together is the fun part.
safetyNotes: Print at 100% size (not "fit to page") so the sheet keeps its true size and the pictures stay the size they were drawn.
screenFreeExtension: Invent one clue of your own for a family word and challenge the table at dinner.
